finding.name: legacy completed compaction can still be re-planned
finding.reproduction: A pre-replay-schema ConversationSegment may have awaiting_compacted_history=true and input_fingerprints exactly equal to the retried compaction input. Because it contains no durable compact payload/fingerprint, the first V16 overlay would miss the replay branch and call Notion again.
finding.required_fix: After current_fingerprints are known and before provider planning, if replay_schema_version==0, awaiting_compacted_history is true, and segment.input_fingerprints exactly equal current_fingerprints, return restart_replay_unavailable. New/appended compaction history may proceed and upgrade the record.

post_fix_expected: legacy exact completed compaction retry => fail closed before provider
new-schema exact retry with durable compaction payload => exact replay, provider count remains 1
